# OmniFetch Pro

> Universal Online Video Downloader for TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and Snapchat without watermarks.

## Core Capabilities
- Extracts HD MP4 videos and 320kbps MP3 audio streams from public social media posts.
- Removes watermarks from TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
- Free to use with zero registration requirements and Progressive Web App support.

## Endpoints
- [Home Page](https://omnifetchpro.com/): Free universal social media downloader interface
- [TikTok Downloader](https://omnifetchpro.com/tiktok): Download TikTok videos without watermark
- [YouTube Downloader](https://omnifetchpro.com/youtube): Convert YouTube videos and Shorts to MP4 and MP3
- [Instagram Downloader](https://omnifetchpro.com/instagram): Save Instagram Reels, Stories, and IGTV videos
- [Facebook Downloader](https://omnifetchpro.com/facebook): High-definition Facebook video saver
- [Twitter Downloader](https://omnifetchpro.com/twitter): Fast Twitter / X video and GIF extractor
- [Media Fetch API](https://omnifetchpro.com/api/fetch-media): Programmatic REST endpoint for media extraction
